card.name: Unit or name word before a list separator
card.fires_on: Words that finish an item in a list or table, such as a unit after a number, a name ending, or the last word of a spell name. The next text is a separator, a slash or a new list entry.

modes.label: Units after numbers
modes.description: A unit such as mg or cells right after a number in dose tables, followed by a slash or a new field.
modes.example: 395 mg/4,800 units every 3 weeks or 790<< mg>>/9,600 units every

modes.label: Last word of a list entry
modes.description: The final word of a name in a dotted list, such as a spell name ending in Charm.
modes.example: Freezing Spell · Seize and Pull Charm · Summoning Charm · Banishing<< Charm>> · Silencing Charm · Mending Charm

modes.label: Name endings in citations
modes.description: The end of a name or term just before a year or a dash.

card.writes: It pushes toward line-ending punctuation like closing brackets and newlines, and away from further list or tag symbols.
card.plain: It marks the end of an item in a list or table, just before the next separator.
